scope: Sustained historical six-deck experiment. The completed short pilot is pipeline evidence, not a learning-budget comparison. Current-Standard integration remains independently gated.

stage1.probe_identity_policy: Freeze independent-seed probe frames before fitting. Exclude their exact digests from every optimizer batch and count exclusions. Never filter probes by loss or game outcome.
stage1.objective: Full legal-distribution Mew policy cross-entropy only. Student chooses its own actions; teacher and student value-head parameters stay frozen. Shared student encoder is policy-trainable.

calibration.objective: Ordinary-initialized value head only, terminal learner-seat outcome MSE. Actor, encoder and buffers remain frozen. No teacher access. Heldout metrics do not select epochs.

ppo.admission: Whole natural-terminal learner-seat episodes from one frozen learner version; collect at least 4096 learner choices before fitting. Censors/faults do not become outcome labels. No incomplete optimizer update becomes a completed checkpoint.
ppo.objective: Teacher-free clipped PPO, student-old-value GAE and terminal Monte Carlo critic MSE. Uniform opponent pool remains fixed. No league or teacher regularization.

evaluation.assignment: 36 ordered six-deck pairs x eight independent pair seeds x two swapped seats. The two legs share the pair seed; all frozen checkpoints share assignments. Separate learner/opponent action generators are seeded by pair, repetition and seat.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired deck-pair/repetition clusters, 288 independent clusters per comparison. Bonferroni over at most seven scheduled checkpoints and two primary comparisons. Include all unresolved outcomes adversarially.
evaluation.opponent: Same frozen uniform legal opponent as training. This is a weak anchor, not a ranked or broad competitive-strength suite.
evaluation.selection: Fixed time snapshots and endpoints only. No evaluation-driven recipe changes, favorable-checkpoint selection, early success stopping or extension. Reuse qualified identical-policy reference results explicitly rather than count them as new games.

budget_accounting: Training learner choices and read-only evaluation choices have distinct counters and predeclared limits. The 7200-second campaign clock never resets at stage transitions or reports. Training stops by campaign second6000 to reserve up to1200 seconds for final576-game evaluation. Every frozen evaluation keeps actual inference cost and decisions. Preserve all short-pilot budgets/evidence unchanged.
runtime: Linux CPU1 per worker, nice19, deterministic eager FP32, no GPU. At most one training worker and one evaluation worker. No live ranked play, cloud spending or private-artifact publication.
stop_rule: Stop at campaign wall or training-step cap and retain the last completed checkpoint. Report negative/inconclusive results. Do not advance to league training.
